title: 砂底の鼓動
caption: creeping boss battle song, skittering metallic percussion, phrygian plucked synth, burrowing sub bass rumble, explosive chorus, desert wind, dusty acoustic guitar, warm analog synth, ochre sunset wasteland, powerful mature female alto rock diva vocal, low husky chest voice, strong belting, passionate and confident, Japanese lyrics, Japanese anime song, J-pop royal road progression, bittersweet melancholic yet uplifting, sorrowful piano and strings fused with breakbeat groove, ethereal reverb, upfront vocal
lyrics:
[Intro - skittering percussion and sub bass]

[Verse 1]
砂の底から 足音が響く
八つの脚で 闇を這い歩く
毒の針先 月に煌めく
逃げ場はないと 大地が呟く

[Pre-Chorus]
鋏が開く その瞬間に
心臓を撃て 迷わずに

[Chorus]
砂を裂いて 目覚めた獣よ
この鼓動で 撃ち抜いてみせよう
針より速く 前へ飛べ
生きて帰ると 誓った夜へ

[Instrumental Break - drum and bass and plucked synth]

[Chorus]
砂を裂いて 目覚めた獣よ
この鼓動で 撃ち抜いてみせよう
針より速く 前へ飛べ
生きて帰ると 誓った夜へ

[Outro - desert wind]
